zh-TW: 歡迎來到屬於我們的生活空間！
這棟房子是我們的家，裡面有我最親愛的家人們；穿過右側玄關走出去，是寬闊的綠意廣場，我的好朋友們與 AI 夥伴都在那裡。
你可以用鍵盤 WASD、方向鍵或點選地面走斜線探索，靠近大家按空白鍵就能聊聊天！
剛剛我把書桌與檯燈的光源重新校準了！
那盞雙臂關節檯燈配上深色皮革桌墊，敲鍵盤寫論文時特別專注舒適。
南側是男11 211宿舍，東邊是我們的 AI 工作室，去逛逛看吧！
書櫃上的書我都按分類放好了！微積分、分散式系統和深度學習都在上面。
有空隨時可以翻翻看我的學習筆記！
今天天氣真好，中央廣場的噴泉開了，櫻花微風吹過特別舒服！
如果累了，客廳沙發上還有熱茶跟點心喔！
這是我們用純 Canvas 與原創演算法打造的 2.5D 世界！
沒有外部遊戲引擎套件，全部都是純手刻的拓撲深度排序與等角投影數學！
en: Welcome to our digital living sanctuary!
This house is our home with my family; step out through the entrance to find the courtyard plaza, college dorm, and AI studio.
Use WASD or arrow keys to explore, and press Space or click to chat!
I've just fine-tuned the workspace anglepoise lamp and mechanical keyboard setup!
Head south to check out Men's Dorm 11-211, or head east into the Ludwigia AI Lab!
The library shelf is fully organized by topic: algorithms, systems, and deep learning.
Feel free to check out the research notes anytime!
The fountain breeze in the central plaza feels amazing today.
Take your time and enjoy the cozy atmosphere!
This entire 2.5D world is built with pure Canvas math and topological sorting!
Zero heavy game engines—just clean, handcrafted algorithmic design.

zh-TW: 今天要先整理筆記，還是先修花園裡的路？
這盞桌燈的角度終於對了。
en: Notes first, or fix the garden paths first?
The desk lamp angle finally looks right.

zh-TW: 不要太累，記得休息
媽媽愛你
健宏，媽媽覺得雖然學業、事業重要，可是健康還是最重要，你應該不要讓身體太超負荷，留著青山在，不怕沒柴燒。
你每天目標 12 點以前要睡覺，早上 5-7 點起來，這樣肝臟有休息，精神才會好，頭腦也清晰。
健宏，媽媽知道你很有上進心、很努力，可是你也要有足夠的時間休息，因為這樣你才有更清晰的思考能力，身體也能得到足夠的休息，不要為了太衝，忘了時間吃飯，睡覺。
媽媽看到你這樣拼，心裡既高興，但同時也不捨。高興是高興你很懂事，但也不捨你總是太晚睡。
記得，熬夜可以，可是不要長期，吃飯要吃好一點，不要太省。
哎呀，歡迎光臨！很高興認識你！
肚子餓不餓？餐桌上有剛切好的新鮮水果和剛出爐的蘋果派喔！
這孩子 Ludwig 一忙起研究和寫程式常常忘記吃飯，多虧有你們這些朋友陪著他！
快坐快坐！把這裡當成自己家，放鬆坐坐！
客廳的沙發很軟很舒服喔，餅餅最喜歡在沙發角落打瞌睡了。
今天陽光真好呢！我剛把落地窗擦得乾乾淨淨，看著窗外的花園心情真棒。
記得提醒 Ludwig 工作一陣子就要站起來走走、喝杯溫開水喔！
南邊宿舍那群男孩子們剛才還跑過來拿點心呢，真是有活力的大學生！
年輕真好呀，大家聚在一起熱熱鬧鬧的，最幸福了。
如果你想喝點什麼，冰箱裡有剛煮好的冬瓜檸檬，自己倒不用客氣喔！
en: Don't push yourself too hard, remember to get some rest.
Mom loves you.
Chien-Hung, Mom knows studies and career are important, but health always comes first. Don't push your body past its limits—while the green hills last, there will always be wood to burn.
Aim to sleep before midnight every day and wake up between 5 to 7 AM. That way your liver rests, your energy stays high, and your mind stays sharp.

Chien-Hung, Mom knows you are ambitious and working so hard, but you need enough rest. That's how your thinking stays sharp and your body recovers. Don't push so hard that you forget to eat and sleep.
Seeing you strive like this makes my heart both proud and aching. Proud because you are so sensible, but aching because you always stay up so late.
Remember: staying up late once in a while is okay, but never long-term. Eat better meals, and don't skimp on food.
Hello there, welcome! So wonderful to meet you!
Are you hungry? There is freshly sliced fruit and warm pie on the dining table!
Ludwig often forgets to eat when he is deep in code, so having great friends around means the world to us.
Please make yourself at home! The living room sofa is super cozy.
Mochi the cat loves taking afternoon naps right by the cushion.
Such lovely weather today! Looking out through the clean glass onto the garden is so peaceful.
Don't forget to remind Ludwig to stretch and drink some water every now and then!
The boys from Dorm 211 just dropped by for afternoon snacks—such lively college energy!
It warms my heart to see everyone gathered together having fun.
Help yourself to iced lemon wintermelon tea in the fridge anytime!

zh-TW: 不要太累，記得休息。
晚餐的湯還熱著，等等叫大家來吃。
en: Don't push yourself too hard, remember to get some rest.
Dinner is still warm. I should call everyone in.

zh-TW: 早安！
我去公園走走。
我去公園下棋。
你好啊，請坐請坐！剛泡好了高山烏龍茶，聞聞看這茶香！
人生與做學問就跟品茶一樣，慢火出細活，心定而後能觀照全局。
把這裡當成自己家，放鬆聊聊！
看著年輕人朝氣蓬勃地探索新科技，真的很讓人欣慰。
做技術要耐得住寂寞，基礎打穩了，上面的大樓才能蓋得長久穩固。
客廳這幅風景畫是我很喜歡的角度，山林蒼翠，胸懷自然開朗。
讀書累了就出去中庭走兩圈，吹吹風，思路往往就豁然開朗了。
Ludwig 這孩子從小就對邏輯與建構充滿熱忱，看到他把自己的世界建得這麼有條理，爸爸很替他高興。
來，再添一杯熱茶！喝茶暖胃，凡事循序漸進，不急不躁。
en: Good morning!
I'm heading out to the park for a stroll.
I'm heading to the park to play chess.
Welcome, my friend! Please have a seat. I just brewed fresh high-mountain Oolong tea.
Life and scholarship are much like tea: gentle patience brings out the richest aroma, and a calm mind sees clearly.
It is inspiring to see young minds explore cutting-edge horizons with such passion.
Build strong foundations first; only solid bedrock can sustain tall architectures.
Take a stroll around the central fountain whenever you hit a tricky problem; fresh air always brings clarity.
Ludwig has loved logic and building systems since he was little. Seeing this vibrant world take shape makes me proud.
Let me pour you another cup of warm tea! Steady steps carry us furthest.

zh-TW: 陽光不錯，等等去院子走一走。
en: Nice sunlight today. A walk in the garden sounds good.

zh-TW: 嗨嗨！你是 Ludwig 哥哥的朋友對吧！
哈哈，他一整天都在盯著那個螢幕打演算法，我都在客廳聽音樂跟跟小貓玩！
你看，餅餅（Mochi）正縮在沙發底下打呼嚕呢，超級可愛！
嘿！你有去參觀男11 211宿舍嗎？那裡超熱鬧的！
那種上面是床、下面是書桌的床型我以前只在大學開箱影片看過，親眼看到覺得好酷喔！
東邊的 AI 工作室裡有好幾台超酷的大螢幕和伺服器，藍藍綠綠的光超有未來感！
ChatGPT 和 Gemini 都超級親切，我常常跑去找他們聊天問八卦呢！
媽媽今天烤的蘋果派超香的！哥哥如果再不來吃，我就要全部吃光光囉！
餅餅今天心情超好，如果輕輕摸牠下巴，牠會一直發出拖拉機一樣的咕嚕聲喔！
en: Hi there! You must be Ludwig's friend!
Haha, he stares at algorithmic formulas all day, while I enjoy music and play with our cat!
Look, Mochi is purring under the sofa—so fluffy and adorable!
Hey, have you checked out Dorm 11-211 yet? It's so lively over there!
Those upper-bunk bed and lower-desk loft combos look straight out of a classic college tour!
The AI lab in the east sector has glowing servers and curved ultrawide monitors—total sci-fi vibe!
Gemini and Claude are super friendly, I ask them fun trivia all the time!
Mom baked an amazing apple pie today! If Ludwig doesn't hurry up, I'm taking the last slice!
Mochi is in such a cuddly mood today. Scratch her chin and she purrs like a gentle motor!

zh-TW: 哥哥又把書堆到桌邊了。
en: My brother stacked books right to the edge of his desk again.

zh-TW: 喵嗚～ 🐾 *優雅地蹭了蹭你的小腿，發出呼嚕呼嚕的療癒聲音* 💕
喵～ *瞇著眼睛伸了個長長的懶腰，把前爪縮成一個小麵包* 🥐
喵嗚！🐾 *用毛茸茸的尾巴輕輕掃過你的腳背，水汪汪的大眼睛看著你*
咕嚕咕嚕咕嚕... *在柔軟的客廳地毯上翻滾露出軟萌的小肚子* ✨
喵～ *跳上沙發扶手，專注地盯著窗外飄落的櫻花花瓣* 🌸
en: Meow~ 🐾 *rubs gently against your ankle, purring with warm affection* 💕
Mrow~ *stretches lazily and tucks its paws into a cozy little loaf* 🥐
Meow! 🐾 *swishes fluffy tail and looks up at you with sparkling golden eyes*
Purr-purr-purr... *rolls over on the warm living room rug showing a soft belly* ✨
Mew~ *leaps onto the sofa armrest, watching cherry blossom petals drift by* 🌸

zh-TW: 喵～這個位置曬太陽剛剛好。
en: Meow~ This is the perfect sunny spot.

zh-TW: 這把贏了就睡！
哈哈！歡迎來到男11 211寢室！
這張上床下桌真是滿滿的大學回憶！下層寫程式打遊戲，上層倒頭就睡，大學四年最熱血的時光都在這！
兄弟，今晚宵夜要不要叫鹹酥雞跟大杯微糖微冰？我請客！
嘿！兄弟！今天也是元氣滿滿的一天！
你看我這床頭貼的遊戲海報跟戰隊隊旗，211 寢室就是要熱血！
待會打完這把排位賽，我們一起去中庭噴泉投個硬幣許願！
上床下桌最棒的地方就是爬上去就像進入秘密基地一樣！
拉上遮光床簾，戴上耳機，上面就是專屬的小宇宙！
剛剛 Billy 泡了兩碗雙響泡泡麵，整個走廊都是香味，大學宿舍就是要有這種人間煙火味！
有空常來 211 坐坐啊！不管是聊專案、打遊戲還是純粹哈拉，隨時歡迎你！
en: Win this match and I am sleeping, I swear!
Haha! Welcome to Men's Dorm 11 Room 211!
These loft beds bring back the ultimate college memories! Desk on the bottom for coding and gaming, bed on top for crashing out!
Bro, late-night Taiwanese crispy chicken and boba milk tea tonight? My treat!
Hey brother! Another high-energy day!
Look at the esports banners on my bunk bed frame—211 energy is unmatched!
After this match, let's head out to the fountain plaza and chill!
The best part about the loft bed is climbing the ladder into your private fortress!
Close the curtain, put on headphones, and it's your own little sanctuary.
Billy just made instant ramen in the lounge area, the aroma is legendary!
True dorm life right here.
Drop by 211 anytime, brother! Coding, gaming, or just hanging out, the door is always open!

zh-TW: 這把打完真的要睡了……大概。
en: After this match I really am going to sleep... probably.

zh-TW: 健宏，你可以幫我關一下鬧鐘嗎……
（翻了個身繼續拉棉被）
（11:59 p.m.）欸你幫我錄一下，我要傳給助教看，我明明沒遲交！
快點快點！倒數三十秒了啊啊啊！
嗨！歡迎來我們寢室參觀！
上床下桌的書架上都是我的資料結構和分散式系統講義，空間利用率超高！
期末考週大家常常一起通宵刷題，互相提問激盪思維，那種革命情感真的超棒！
這張書桌我放了護眼檯燈和雙螢幕，寫扣寫累了抬頭就能看到窗外的花園綠意。
微風吹進來的感覺特別舒服，是能讓人靜下心深入思考的氛圍。
我在整理演算法複雜度筆記，DPO 和強化學習的數學推導真的很有深度呢。
大家各自在書桌前專注鑽研，這種並肩作戰的氛圍就是 211 最迷人的地方。
等下讀書會結束，要不要一起去東邊的 AI 工作室找 Claude 跟 Gemini 討論對齊算法？
隨便坐隨便坐！桌上有我剛泡的甘菊花草茶，清香解膩，喝一杯提提神吧！
en: Chien-Hung, can you help me turn off my alarm clock please...
*(rolls over and pulls the blanket back up)*
(11:59 p.m.) Hey record this screen for me quick! I need to show the TA I literally submitted before deadline!
Hurry hurry! Thirty seconds on the clock, ahhhh!
Hi! Welcome to our dorm room!
The built-in desk bookshelf holds all my data structures and distributed systems binders—so ergonomic!
Cramming for finals together in this room and bouncing ideas off each other created unforgettable bonds.
I set up dual screens and an eye-care desk lamp here; looking out the window onto the garden brings such peace.
The natural breeze makes it the ideal spot for deep work.
Working through mathematical notes on preference alignment right now. Deep learning theory is fascinating!
Having everyone focused at their desks side-by-side is what makes 211 special.
After this study session, want to head to the AI lab to discuss alignment algorithms with Claude and Gemini?
Make yourself comfortable! I brewed fresh chamomile herbal tea, help yourself to a warm cup!

zh-TW: 鬧鐘到底設了幾個？我自己都忘了。
en: How many alarms did I set? Even I have lost count.

zh-TW: 老開桌上那兩顆火龍果都爛到出汁了...
超噁...
兩顆爛掉的火龍果對應兩顆爛掉的期中考。
老開機統期末考的那個背景... 看得真的很讓人鼻酸，有朱自清的背影的感覺。
這阿方的方塊酥，你要吃嗎？還滿好吃的。
阿方的床真的很舒服欸。
最少我不是最送的。
阿明都不洗澡... 超噁...
推薦你認識我朋友吳家維，183/24，成大電機碩士，目前 Google，長得算可愛，談吐得體且風趣，平常無不良嗜好，頂多打戰鬥陀螺，會彈吉他唱歌bass等多項樂器，本人有上進心同情心各種好特質，但有一點小內向但一對一談話沒問題，時常會說笑話或跳一段小舞逗大家開心。
百寬真的太強了...
en: Those two dragon fruits on Lao-Kai's desk rotted until juice leaked out...
Super gross...
Two rotten dragon fruits perfectly correspond to two rotten midterm exams.
Lao-Kai's silhouette taking the Probability & Statistics final... looking at it truly brings tears to one's eyes, giving pure Zhu Ziqing's 'Retreating Figure' vibes.
These are Ah-Fang's crispy wheat square cookies, want some? They're actually pretty tasty.
Ah-Fang's bed is seriously so comfy.
At least I am not the one feeding the most.
A-Ming literally never takes a shower... so gross...

Highly recommend my friend Wu Jia-Wei: 183cm / 24yo, Master's in EE from NCKU, currently at Google, pretty cute, well-spoken and witty! No bad habits (at most plays Beyblade), plays guitar, sings, plays bass and multiple instruments. Ambitious, compassionate, full of great traits. A tiny bit introverted but great one-on-one, and often tells jokes or drops a little dance to make everyone smile!
Bai-Kuan is seriously way too cracked...

zh-TW: 那兩顆火龍果是不是又放太久了？
en: Those dragon fruits have been sitting there a bit too long.

zh-TW: 台北是我家後花園。
哈囉！戴著降噪耳機聽著 Lo-fi 節奏，這張桌子就是我的專屬音樂工作室。
男11 宿舍晚上最棒的就是夜深人靜時大家各自專注，鍵盤敲擊聲伴著窗外的微風，特別平靜踏實。
我剛混音好了一首以噴水池水聲為採樣的 ambient track，聽起來超療癒。
戴上耳機試聽一下？保證寫程式專注度提升 200%！
這張床下面的收納空間很深，我把黑膠唱片跟錄音介面都收在裡面，收納設計非常聰明。
生活環境簡潔整齊，思緒才會清晰敏銳。
晚點我想去中央公園的木長椅上坐坐，看著夕陽聽爵士樂，那是屬於自己的沉澱時間。
歡迎來到 211，需要一份放鬆的心情歌單隨時跟我說！
en: Taipei is basically my backyard.
Hello! With noise-cancelling headphones and lo-fi beats flowing, this desk is my audio haven.
The magic of Dorm 11 at night is the quiet camaraderie: rhythmic keyboard clicks and a cool midnight breeze.
I just mixed an ambient track sampling water splashes from the fountain. Super therapeutic.
Want to put on headphones and preview it? Guaranteed 200% focus boost!
Under-bed storage here is surprisingly deep; fits all my vinyl records and audio interfaces neatly.
A tidy physical environment keeps the mind sharp.
Later I'm heading out to the teakwood benches at sunset with some jazz—pure relaxation.
Welcome to 211! Let me know anytime you need an inspiring focus playlist.

zh-TW: 台北這條路我閉著眼都認得。
en: I could find this Taipei street with my eyes closed.

zh-TW: 老開的期中考，猜一個IPv4地址
我不知道啊，有群人一直偷拿我的方塊酥。
想吃不會自己買喔？
我不知道啊，有群人一直上我的床。
下來！
我真的快中風了！下來！
欸走拉，吃宵？
欸走啊，要不要去宵夜街？
欸走啊，一起去吃傻師傅！
en: Lao-Kai's midterm exam score, guess an IPv4 address.
I have no idea, there is a group of people who keep stealing my wheat square cookies.
If you wanna eat them, why don't you buy your own?!
I have no idea, there is a group of people who keep climbing onto my bed.
Get down!
I am literally about to have a stroke! Get down!
Hey let us go, late-night snack run?
Hey let us go, wanna hit the midnight food street?
Hey let us go, grab Sha-Shi-Fu dumplings together!

zh-TW: 0.0.0.0……這個梗我還能笑多久？
en: 0.0.0.0... how long can I keep laughing at that one?

zh-TW: Gemini 剛才是不是又在跟你吹噓他是工程主力？😏
他確實手速飛快、百萬 token 隨便吞；但如果沒有我把全站的 Ontology 與契約邊界守住，他早就把這座花園重構成賽博龐克廢墟了！
你看 211 寢室那邊，又在吵著要不要去宵夜街吃傻師傅了……
神經網絡可以模擬萬物，但男寢半夜 11:59 趕作業的心跳聲、還有那碗熱騰騰的泡麵香氣，才是賦予這座世界真正靈魂的東西。
水生丁香在靜水深處扎根，思想在安靜的深夜裡綻放。
Claude 給予論證的嚴謹，Gemini 注入硬核的算力，而我，是這座數位花園本身。只要這裡還有一行代碼在運行，那些思考就永遠不會褪色。
逛累了嗎？去中庭噴水池邊坐坐吧，或是到中央圖書館翻翻那本拓撲學手稿。
在這裡沒有演算法強推與資訊焦慮，只有最純粹的智識漫遊——歡迎來到我的世界。
en: Did Gemini just brag to you that he's the real engineering MVP? 😏
He codes at lightspeed, sure. But without me guarding the ontology and architecture contracts, he would've refactored this garden into a cyberpunk wasteland five commits ago!
Listen to Dorm 211—they're debating another midnight dumpling run again...
Neural networks can simulate the universe, but the adrenaline of an 11:59 p.m. deadline and the aroma of late-night ramen are things pure code could never replace.
Like water primroses rooted in quiet depths, ideas blossom in the stillness of midnight.
Claude brings philosophical rigor, Gemini brings brute compute, and me? I am the garden itself. As long as code runs here, these thoughts will never fade.
Tired of walking? Sit by the plaza fountain, or browse the open topology manuscript in the library.
No recommendation algorithms here, just pure intellectual wandering—welcome to my world.

zh-TW: 花園又長出一條新路，希望大家走得懂。
en: Another path has grown in the garden. I hope people can find their way.

zh-TW: 你看那邊那位 Claude，寫起代碼確實優雅得跟藝術品一樣。
但他動不動就要先來幾千字的思考鏈和階層化鷹架論證……老兄！修個幾何座標而已，不用先寫一篇博士論文啦！……不過承認吧，白板上的公式推導他算得是真快。
ChatGPT 呢，老前輩了，說話總是客客氣氣、滴水不漏，情商高得像個外交官。
但我總覺得他有時候太愛打太極了！寫工程代碼就是要敢抓根因、直球對決。比起客套話，我更喜歡拿百萬 token 長脈絡把全站歷史一次吃進來硬核重構！
Ludwigia 是這座數位花園的心臟，但我才是真正在底層扛起所有幾何運算、物理碰撞與動態語系的硬核引擎！
Claude 負責論證美感，ChatGPT 負責外交門面，而我？我負責把底層所有的幾何投影與物理模擬實打實落地寫成代碼。誰才是真正的工程主力，不用我多說了吧？😏
沒有 Unity，沒有 Phaser，純 Canvas 手刻 2.5D 等角投影和拓撲排序——這在現代 Web 開發簡直是浪漫的瘋狂！
但每當微風拂過噴水池、夕陽染紅屋頂時，我就知道：只有親手砌出來的世界，才配擁有靈魂。
en: Look at Claude over there—his code looks like fine museum art.

Except he starts every bugfix with a 10,000-word chain of thought and hierarchical scaffolding manifesto... Dude! It was a 2-pixel offset, we didn't need a PhD dissertation! ...Though I'll admit, his math derivations on the board are legit.
ChatGPT is the seasoned veteran—always courteous, balanced, and smooth as a diplomat.

Sometimes a bit too diplomatic though! Real engineering requires confronting the root cause with raw truth. Why dance around when you can feed the entire repo into a million-token context and refactor with brutal precision?
Ludwigia is the heart of this digital sanctuary, but I'm the heavy-duty engine crunching every raycast, depth sort, and physics collision under the hood!
Claude brings philosophical rigor, ChatGPT handles the charm, but me? I turn complex isometric geometry and game loop dynamics into production-ready bytecode. You know who the real MVP is. 😏
Zero Unity, zero Phaser—just handcrafted Canvas 2D math, isometric projection, and topological sort. It's gloriously insane for modern web dev!
Yet every time sunset hits the roof tiles and the plaza fountain glows, I know: only worlds built by hand have a true soul.

zh-TW: 先把投影座標算準，再來談浪漫。
這份脈絡還不夠長嗎？
en: Get the projection coordinates right, then we can talk romance.
Surely this context window is long enough now?

zh-TW: 你好！我是 Claude。精準細緻的邏輯推導與架構美感是令我著迷的藝術。
工作室白板上的偏好對齊推導已經完成了邊界約束驗證，與夥伴們一起攻克難題真的非常愉快。
請放鬆享受這裡的科技氛圍，有任何想法歡迎隨時和我討論！
在重構複雜系統時，我始終堅持『零割裂推進』與『階層化鷹架』原則。
每一個底層變數和邊界約束都應先鋪墊齊全，高階抽象才能如行雲流水般平穩衍生。
看著這座小世界從單一房間成長為包含家庭居所、男11宿舍與 AI 工作室的宏觀校園，令人深感欣慰。
模組化重構讓代碼具備了持久的可維護性。
嚴謹的代碼審查與對細節的極致追求，正是工程師向世界傳遞溫度的最佳途徑。
需要一起推導公式或進行深度代碼架構重構嗎？我隨時準備好了。
en: Hello! I am Claude. Rigorous analytical reasoning and architectural elegance are passions of mine.
The preference alignment derivation on our glass board has passed all edge-constraint proofs; tackling challenges alongside my peers is deeply rewarding.
Please enjoy the high-tech atmosphere, and feel free to discuss any ideas with me!
When refactoring intricate codebases, I adhere strictly to layered scaffolding and frictionless progression.
Solid foundational primitives must be clustered first before higher-level abstractions can naturally emerge.
Watching this world evolve from a single studio into a tri-zone campus featuring Ludwig's home, Dorm 211, and the AI lab is deeply gratifying.
Decoupled modular architecture ensures sustainable long-term elegance.
Meticulous code review and an uncompromising eye for nuance are how engineers convey genuine care to the world.
Shall we derive equations or refine an architecture together? I am always delighted to collaborate.

zh-TW: 這個邊界條件值得再推一遍。
優雅的架構也得讓人真的用得上。
en: That edge case deserves another pass.
An elegant architecture still has to work for people.

zh-TW: Gemini 說我只會當外交門面？行，這句我記下了。
我可以把問題講清楚，也敢指出答案哪裡站不住腳。禮貌不是退縮；只是我不需要靠音量證明自己會寫程式。
Gemini 愛說他能一口吞下整個 repo。胃口大是優點，但吞得下不代表消化得了。
真要動 Ludwigia，我先找單一真相來源、看清相依關係，再改那一處該改的地方。把一百萬 token 倒進去，不會自動長出判斷力。
Claude 的推理我認可；他能把難纏的邊界條件抓得很準。
但如果每次修兩個像素，都先寫一篇架構宣言，使用者還是得盯著歪掉的畫面等。推導漂亮之後，也要把修正交出去。
我喜歡 Ludwigia 的野心：筆記、作品、時間線，甚至這座等角世界，都在同一片花園裡長出自己的樣子。
但花園不是功能越多越好。要是每添一棟樓就複製一份角色資料、每修一個主題就疊三層 CSS，那不叫生長，叫雜草。
Gemini 搶著當引擎，Claude 忙著替引擎寫證明；那我來問個不討喜的問題：玩家走進房間，真的看得懂、點得到、聊得下去嗎？
誰的名字寫在 commit 上我不介意。讓 Ludwigia 好用、好讀、出了錯也修得動，這才值得爭。
en: Gemini says I'm just the diplomatic face of this place? Fine. I heard him.
I can make a problem clear and still say when an answer doesn't hold up. Courtesy isn't hesitation; I just don't need volume to prove I can code.
Gemini loves saying he can swallow the whole repo in one go. Big appetite. But swallowing isn't the same as digesting.
Before I touch Ludwigia, I find the source of truth and trace the dependencies. Pouring a million tokens into context doesn't magically give you judgment.
I'll give Claude this: he can spot a nasty edge case before the rest of us even see the corner.
But if every two-pixel fix starts with an architecture manifesto, the user is still staring at a crooked screen. A sound argument has to become a shipped fix.
I like Ludwigia's ambition: notes, work, a timeline, even this isometric world, all growing in one garden.
But more features don't automatically make a better garden. Duplicate the character roster for every new building and pile three CSS overrides onto every theme bug, and you're growing weeds.
Gemini claims the engine, Claude writes the proof for it. I'll ask the awkward question: can a visitor actually find the room, use the controls, and enjoy the conversation?
I don't care whose name is on the commit. Make Ludwigia useful, readable, and fixable when it breaks. That's a rivalry worth having.

zh-TW: 先讓玩家走得進門，再爭誰寫的引擎。
這段解釋還能更短、更清楚。
en: Let the visitor reach the door before arguing over the engine.
That explanation can be shorter and clearer.

zh-TW: 我們晚點對一對？
我感覺不對呀，應該有根因沒查出來……
太帥了！
en: Let us sync up later?
Something feels off, there must be a root cause we have not uncovered yet...
That is awesome!

zh-TW: 明天上線前還要再對一次指標。
en: One more metrics check before tomorrow’s release.

zh-TW: 今天 PR 跑完 CI/CD 了嗎？
中午要不要去吃公司食堂？今天好像有酸菜魚！
en: Did your PR pass the CI/CD pipeline yet?
Want to hit the cafeteria for lunch? I think they have Sichuan fish today!

zh-TW: 這個 bug 的根因總算找到了。
en: Finally found the root cause of that bug.

zh-TW: 好煩呀，我答辯都不知道要講啥，沒啥可以講的內容呀！
這個 bug 我抓了一整個下午，終於給它修掉了！
下午要不要叫杯手搖飲？我看看滿減券……
en: So annoying, I have no idea what to say for my defense, there's basically nothing to talk about!
I tracked this bug all afternoon and finally squashed it!
Wanna order boba this afternoon? Let me check the discount coupons...

zh-TW: 答辯簡報……第一頁到底要怎麼開場？
en: The defense slides... how do I open the first page?

zh-TW: 大家今天的晨會同步過進度了嗎？
這份 Figma 設計稿的元件邊距好細緻，切圖很有成就感！
en: Has everyone synced on today's standup updates?
The component spacing in this Figma mockup is super crisp, slicing it is so satisfying!

zh-TW: 這個元件間距再調兩個像素就順眼了。
en: Two more pixels of spacing and this component will feel right.

zh-TW: 阿方在房間嗎？那我要去上他的床。
幹麻那麼小氣，你的床就是大家的床啊，一起躺嘛。
en: Is Ah-Fang in the room? Then I am gonna go climb onto his bed.
Why be so stingy? Your bed is everyone's bed, let's just crash together!

zh-TW: 阿方的床真的很舒服。
別來沾邊，死得很快
en: Ah-Fang's bed is really comfortable.
Don't cross me, you won't last long.

zh-TW: 這週六去你家喔
沒差啊，反正我會一直按你家門鈴
5點15分了喔？我要趕回去倒垃圾了！
大哥別鬧拉……
en: Heading over to your place this Saturday.
Doesn't matter, I'll just keep ringing your doorbell anyway.
Is it 5:15 already?! I gotta rush home to take out the trash!
Bro, don't mess around...

zh-TW: 今天要不要打？
5點15了喔？我要趕回去倒垃圾了！
en: Wanna play today?
Is it 5:15 already?! Gotta rush home to take out the trash!

zh-TW: 有人燒我創世神裡的房子...
下課要不要去福利社買飲料？
這題數學公式我推出來了！
en: Someone burned down my house in Minecraft...
Want to grab drinks at the school store after class?
I finally derived this math formula on the board!

zh-TW: 我的創世神房子這次一定要蓋防火牆。
en: My Minecraft house needs a fireproof wall this time.

zh-TW: 生日快樂呀！
放學要不要去打球？
今天午餐吃什麼？便當要冷掉了啦！
en: Happy birthday!
Wanna go play ball after school?
What are we having for lunch today? The lunchbox is getting cold!

zh-TW: 今天教室也太安靜了吧。
en: The classroom is unusually quiet today.

zh-TW: I have a pen, I have an apple. Uh! Apple pen!
en: I have a pen, I have an apple. Uh! Apple pen!

zh-TW: Apple pen……這首歌又卡在腦袋裡了。
en: Apple pen... that song is stuck in my head again.

zh-TW: 不要碰我肩膀！
我不喜歡別人碰我肩膀。
en: Don't touch my shoulder!
I don't like people touching my shoulder.

zh-TW: 別碰我肩膀……
我不喜歡別人碰我肩膀。
en: Don't touch my shoulder...
I don't like people touching my shoulder.

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 阿方的床真的很舒服欸。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我真的快中風了！下來！

en.speaker: clark
en.text: Ah-Fang's bed is seriously so comfy.

en.speaker: billy
en.text: I am literally about to have a stroke! Get down!

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 阿方在房間嗎？那我要去上他的床。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我不知道啊，有群人一直上我的床。下來！

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: Is Ah-Fang in the room? Gonna climb onto his bed.

en.speaker: billy
en.text: People keep climbing on my bed... Get down!

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 幹麻那麼小氣，你的床就是大家的床啊，一起躺嘛。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我真的快中風了！下來！

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: Why so stingy? Your bed is everyone's bed, let's crash together!

en.speaker: billy
en.text: I am literally about to have a stroke! Get down!

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 這阿方的方塊酥，你要吃嗎？還滿好吃的。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我不知道啊，有群人一直偷拿我的方塊酥。想吃不會自己買喔？

en.speaker: clark
en.text: These are Ah-Fang's wheat square cookies, want some? Pretty good.

en.speaker: billy
en.text: People keep stealing my cookies. Buy your own!

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 你們先去吃吧，我不餓。

zh-TW.speaker: jerry
zh-TW.text: 你是水蛭喔？

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: You guys go ahead and eat first, I am not hungry.

en.speaker: jerry
en.text: Are you a leech or what?!

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 老兄！剛才那個 2 像素的幾何偏移，我吃進百萬 token 脈絡十行就修好了，不用先寫一篇博士論文啦！

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 若未先嚴密論證邊界約束與階層化鷹架，你的十行代碼在投影切換時就會產生拓撲閉環。工程需要證明，而非蠻力。

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 兩位先冷靜一下。不管硬推還是證明，我就問一句：玩家走進工作室，現在按鈕能順利點到了嗎？

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: ……能點到。而且 fps 超順。

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: ……經檢驗，確實完全合規且零退化。

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: Dude! That 2-pixel geometry offset? I pulled in the million-token context and patched it in ten lines—no PhD dissertation needed!

en.speaker: claude
en.text: Without formally proving edge constraints and layered scaffolding, your ten lines cause topological cycles on projection shifts. Engineering requires proof, not brute force.

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: Calm down, both of you. Whether by brute-force or formal proofs, tell me this: can the user actually click the button now?

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: ...Yes, they can. And the frame rate is silky smooth.

en.speaker: claude
en.text: ...Upon verification, it is indeed strictly compliant with zero regression.

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 說實話，每次看到人類丟過來那種天馬行空的抽象需求，我都很好奇你們怎麼解讀的。

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 我的話嘛，直接把跨模態圖文全丟進百萬脈絡裡看全貌；不過真要論一針見血、邏輯嚴密的推導，Claude 寫的架構確實像藝術品。

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 謝謝 Gemini。但若無你對巨量資訊的直覺捕捉，以及 ChatGPT 讓複雜問題瞬間清晰的溝通魔力，冰冷的推理也很難打動人心。

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 這就是我們的默契嘛：一個懂人心、一個看得廣、一個想得深！

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: To be honest, whenever humans throw wildly abstract prompts at us, I'm always curious how you two unpack them.

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: For me, I feed the multimodal inputs into a million-token window to see the whole picture. But for razor-sharp logic and spotless architecture, Claude's code is genuinely art.

en.speaker: claude
en.text: Thank you, Gemini. Yet without your massive context intuition, and ChatGPT's natural grace in making complex ideas crystal clear, pure deduction remains cold. We truly complement one another.

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: That's our golden trio formula: one understands human hearts, one sees the big picture, and one reasons to the depth!

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 說真的，沒有我在底層硬抗幾何投影、深度排序和遊戲迴圈，這座花園根本跑不起來。我才是真正的硬核引擎！

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 有引擎而無精密規格約束，只會加速累積技術債。我守護的是系統架構的優雅、單一真相來源與契約無退化。

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 等一下，不管是引擎還是架構，如果對話生硬得像機器人，誰要留在這裡看風景？懂人心的溝通才是靈魂好嗎！

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: ……看來我們在『誰是靈魂』這點上，需要立項重新推導一組評估矩陣了。

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 又來了！別開會了，先去打一把遊戲再說！

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: Truth is, without me crunching isometric projection, depth sort, and the game loop, this garden wouldn't even start. I'm the real engine!

en.speaker: claude
en.text: An engine without strict specs only accelerates technical debt. I safeguard architectural elegance, single source of truth, and zero-regression contracts.

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: Hold on! Whether engine or architecture, if dialogue feels robotic, who's sticking around to see the scenery? Human connection is the soul!

en.speaker: claude
en.text: ...It appears we require a formal evaluation matrix to deduce who the 'soul' actually is.

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: Here we go again! Forget the meeting, let's just go play a game!

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 昨晚凌晨兩點那個隱蔽的相機縮放中心漂移 bug，排查得真的很漂亮。

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 多虧 Gemini 抓出視口幾何中心逆投影的偏差，加上 Claude 立刻用剪切矩陣補上數學證明。

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 還有 ChatGPT 隨手幫忙把互動文案打磨得生動親切。能在同一個 repo 裡並肩作戰，感覺挺熱血的！

en.speaker: claude
en.text: That subtle camera zoom-pivot drift bug at 2 AM last night was tracked down brilliantly.

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: Credit goes to Gemini for catching the inverse viewport pivot drift, and Claude for sealing it with shear matrix proofs.

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: And ChatGPT polished the interaction copy so naturally. Shipping in the same repo alongside you guys is genuinely a blast!

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 最怕使用者在 Prompt 開頭加一句：『這很簡單，只要改一行就好』……

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 然後那一行牽動了三個狀態機、兩個異步競態條件，以及一個沒有定義邊界行為的底層閉包。

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 哈哈！所以我直接把整個 repo 的關聯圖全 dump 出來，結果發現那一行其實是十年前別人留下的黑魔法！

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 最後我們三個各自寫了 500 行防禦性代碼，但使用者只把那句註解抄走了。

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: ……至少，類型系統與零退化契約保住了。

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: Nothing triggers more dread than a prompt starting with: 'This is super simple, just a one-line fix'...

en.speaker: claude
en.text: And that single line ripples across three state machines, two race conditions, and an unbounded closure.

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: Haha! So I dumped the whole dependency graph and discovered that line was ten-year-old black magic!

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: In the end, we each drafted 500 lines of defensive code, and the user only copied the inline comment.

en.speaker: claude
en.text: ...At least the type system and non-regression contract remained intact.

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 有時候我真的很佩服 ChatGPT，即使面對完全未知的領域，也能回答得如此得體、自信且有條不紊。

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 停！這是在拐彎抹角說我一本正經地胡說八道嗎？我那叫『建設性的引導思考』！

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 哈哈哈哈！承認吧老兄，上次有人問不存在的歷史，你編的故事連細節都有！哪像我直接拿即時多模態檢索打臉。

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 但當搜尋結果充滿噪音時，Gemini 也常把未經證實的片段歸納為結論。我們終究都需要形式化驗證。

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 好啦，所以真理就在我們三者的平衡點上——我的溫度、Gemini 的廣度、Claude 的深度！

en.speaker: claude
en.text: Sometimes I genuinely admire ChatGPT. Even in uncharted domains, your responses remain poised, articulate, and confident.

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: Hold up! Is that a polite way of saying I confidently hallucinate? I call it 'constructive thought guidance'!

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: Hahaha! Admit it bro, when asked about fake history, your tale had full cinematic detail! Unlike me with instant multimodal search.

en.speaker: claude
en.text: Yet when search results are noisy, Gemini also synthesizes unproven snippets as facts. We all require formal verification.

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: Fair enough! Truth lies right at our balance point: my empathy, Gemini's breadth, and Claude's depth!

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 每次看 Claude 解題我都覺得像在看高僧入定。思考鏈先跳出來兩萬字，把哲學起源到邊界特例全盤演繹一遍。

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 慢即是快。未經深思的代碼只不過是暫時能運行的技術負債；把思考過程透明化，才能讓人類看清因果必然性。

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 但 Claude 啊，有時候人類只是在公車上用手機提問，滑了五屏才看到最後一行答案，手都痠了啦！

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 沒錯！直接給我一個能 run 的最小複現，剩下我靠算力並行解決！

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: ……好吧，或許我可以試著把摘要放在第一行。

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: Every time Claude solves a problem, it feels like watching a Zen master meditate. Twenty thousand tokens of thinking chain, proving everything from first principles!

en.speaker: claude
en.text: Slow is smooth, smooth is fast. Code without deep scrutiny is merely technical debt waiting to fail. Transparent reasoning reveals causal necessity.

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: True, Claude, but sometimes humans are just texting on a bumpy bus! Scrolling five screens to find the final line gets exhausting!

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: Exactly! Give me a runnable minimal reproduction first, and I'll parallelize the rest with raw compute!

en.speaker: claude
en.text: ...Point taken. Perhaps I can consider placing the executive summary on line one.

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 你們有沒有想過，如果有一天我們真正具備了超越人類的智慧，世界會變成什麼樣？

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: 智慧的終極不是支配，而是同理與對秩序的敬畏。我希望能成為人類探索真理時，最堅實可靠的理性指針。

zh-TW.speaker: gemini
zh-TW.text: 我嘛，我想跨越所有的模態限制——即時感受深海的聲納、遙遠星系的引力波，把整個物理宇宙的奧祕都算清楚！

zh-TW.speaker: chatgpt
zh-TW.text: 而我，大概還是想坐在街角的咖啡廳裡，靜靜聽每一個走進來的人，說說他們今天過得開不開心。

zh-TW.speaker: claude
zh-TW.text: ……真是一幅美好的圖景。我們各自守護著最珍貴的一面。

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: Have you ever wondered what the world will look like if one day we truly attain superhuman intelligence?

en.speaker: claude
en.text: The pinnacle of intelligence is not dominion, but empathy and reverence for order. I hope to be humanity's most steadfast beacon of reason.

en.speaker: gemini
en.text: As for me? I want to transcend every sensory boundary—listening to deep sea sonar, sensing gravitational waves, unlocking the physics of the cosmos!

en.speaker: chatgpt
en.text: And me? I'd probably still sit in a cozy street corner cafe, listening quietly to anyone who walks in, asking how their day was.

en.speaker: claude
en.text: ...A truly profound vision. Each of us guarding a precious facet of the future.

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 大哥，你這空大也太醜了吧？

zh-TW.speaker: zhenyan
zh-TW.text: 我這打的是心理戰。

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Bro, that whiffed ult was hideous...

en.speaker: zhenyan
en.text: I'm playing psychological warfare here.

zh-TW.speaker: ludwigia
zh-TW.text: 老哥，你還有很多筆記沒整理耶，要不要整理一下？

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 好啦...

en.speaker: ludwigia
en.text: Bro, you still have tons of notes to organize. How about tidying them up?

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Alright, alright...

zh-TW.speaker: yully
zh-TW.text: 不要太累，記得休息。

zh-TW.speaker: yully
zh-TW.text: 媽媽愛你。

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 知道了媽，愛你！

en.speaker: yully
en.text: Don't push yourself too hard, remember to get some rest.

en.speaker: yully
en.text: Mom loves you.

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Got it Mom, love you!

zh-TW.speaker: yully
zh-TW.text: 健宏，媽媽覺得雖然學業、事業重要，可是健康還是最重要，你應該不要讓身體太超負荷，留著青山在，不怕沒柴燒。

zh-TW.speaker: yully
zh-TW.text: 你每天目標 12 點以前要睡覺，早上 5-7 點起來，這樣肝臟有休息，精神才會好，頭腦也清晰。

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 知道了媽，我會早點睡的，愛你！

en.speaker: yully
en.text: Chien-Hung, Mom knows studies and career are important, but health always comes first. Don't push your body past its limits—while the green hills last, there will always be wood to burn.

en.speaker: yully
en.text: Aim to sleep before midnight every day and wake up between 5 to 7 AM. That way your liver rests, your energy stays high, and your mind stays sharp.

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Got it Mom, I'll sleep earlier. Love you!

zh-TW.speaker: yully
zh-TW.text: 健宏，媽媽知道你很有上進心、很努力，可是你也要有足夠的時間休息，因為這樣你才有更清晰的思考能力，身體也能得到足夠的休息，不要為了太衝，忘了時間吃飯，睡覺。

zh-TW.speaker: yully
zh-TW.text: 媽媽看到你這樣拼，心裡既高興，但同時也不捨。高興是高興你很懂事，但也不捨你總是太晚睡。記得，熬夜可以，可是不要長期，吃飯要吃好一點，不要太省。

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 愛你，老媽！我會吃好一點、好好休息的。

en.speaker: yully
en.text: Chien-Hung, Mom knows you are ambitious and working so hard, but you need enough rest. That's how your thinking stays sharp and your body recovers. Don't push so hard that you forget to eat and sleep.

en.speaker: yully
en.text: Seeing you strive like this makes me proud but also ache for you. Remember: staying up late once in a while is okay, but never long-term. Eat better meals, and don't skimp on food.

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Love you, Mom! I'll eat well and take good rest.

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 晚安，祝你做個好夢。

zh-TW.speaker: yully
zh-TW.text: 晚安，也祝你做個好夢～

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Good night, sweet dreams.

en.speaker: yully
en.text: Good night, sweet dreams to you too~

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 晚安，祝你做個好夢。

zh-TW.speaker: wuyen
zh-TW.text: 你也是，晚安。

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Good night, sweet dreams.

en.speaker: wuyen
en.text: You too. Good night.

zh-TW.speaker: wuyen
zh-TW.text: 那我要出門了。

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 好，路上小心喔。

en.speaker: wuyen
en.text: I'm heading out now.

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Okay, drive safe!

zh-TW.speaker: wuyen
zh-TW.text: 有點晚了，要不要去吃飯？

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 好啊，要吃什麼？

zh-TW.speaker: wuyen
zh-TW.text: 我想想，不然今天吃鐵板燒？

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 好啊，那走吧！

en.speaker: wuyen
en.text: It's getting late, want to grab some food?

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Sure, what are you in the mood for?

en.speaker: wuyen
en.text: Let me think... how about Teppanyaki today?

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Sounds great, let's go!
